target.title: Doctor: audit lint default selection
target.body:
## Summary
- Adds an executable audit for all 48 Doctor lint checks now that every tracked Doctor rule family has structured lint findings.
- Moves historical/advisory or environment-inventory checks out of default `doctor --lint`: legacy state, session transcripts, session snapshots, and skills readiness now require `--all` or `--only`.
- Leaves the health-check/data/plugin/config contracts unchanged; this is internal lint selection metadata plus test coverage.

Stacking note: this is intended to follow #100093. Until #100093 lands, this PR's GitHub diff includes the write-config lint slice underneath it.

## Default-lint bar encoded here
Default `doctor --lint` should be broad-safe: local, deterministic, low-noise, and actionable for most users. Historical cleanup, optional inventory, live service state, account/channel-specific probes, and repair-oriented checks should stay explicit via `--lint --all` or `--lint --only <id>`.

## Empty/default install smoke
Source-level isolated smoke after this change:
- `doctor --lint --json` on an absent config/state under temp `HOME` runs 19 checks, skips 29, and reports only `gateway-config`, `gateway-auth`, and source-checkout `ui-protocol-freshness`.
- `doctor --lint --json --all` remains intentionally not clean on an unconfigured temp install because `--all` includes explicit state/live/plugin/account inventory checks such as state integrity, gateway daemon/health, memory search, plugin registry, and skills readiness.

This confirms the audit reduced empty-install noise, but also confirms strict `--all` cleanliness on an unconfigured install is not the current semantics of `--all`.

## Validation
- `corepack pnpm exec vitest run src/flows/doctor-core-checks.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts src/flows/doctor-lint-defaults-audit.test.ts --pool forks --maxWorkers 1 --no-fileParallelism --reporter dot`
- `corepack pnpm exec oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-lint-defaults-audit.test.ts`
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-lint-defaults-audit.test.ts`
- `corepack pnpm tsgo:core`
- `git diff --check`
